One key for many providers' models through OpenAI's API shape, from a gateway hosted in the EU. Requests can be pinned to EU-hosted regions, and audit logs and traces stay in EU storage.

## API key

1. Sign in or sign up at [platform.opper.ai](https://platform.opper.ai).
2. Open **API Keys** and create a key.
3. Copy the key.

Add it to your Gateway. It asks for the key:

```bash
everyapp provider add opper
```

To make it the model provider apps get by default:

```bash
everyapp ai default opper
```

### Use it in an app

In the app's `everyapp.config.ts`:

```ts
providers: ["opper"],
```

The app calls `/api/ai/opper/…` with `createGatewayFetch()`. More in [AI](/docs/agent/ai).

**Check it worked:** `everyapp ai list` shows `opper` with its key set.

**Cost:** Token rates are the model providers' rates with no markup; Opper charges a 3% fee when you buy credits (5.5% with Control Plane features).

Something wrong or missing? [Open an issue](https://github.com/every-app/every-app/issues/new?template=provider-request.yml&title=Provider%20guide%3A%20Opper).
